sequence_method: Reuse weekly V1: two-week cost average, asymmetric mismatch impulses, fixed 0.5 weekly decay, eight-transition warmup
calibration: Absolute retail margin; intercept and two nonnegative slopes; standardized ridge alpha=2; latest eight published feature-complete quarters; no prior-year anchor
training_cutoff: Completed quarters and outcomes published strictly before target quarter-end; minimum eight; no missing feature filler
weights: Archived current-vintage EIA national-demand times regional store weights; explicit proxy, not MUSA observed gallons
boundary: Existing weekly V1 final partial-week carry only; no internal gaps or future-week data
activation: Every eligible modern quarter, not only known misses; one frozen candidate, no parameter search
disclosure_route: Same-basis retail, verified and available by cutoff; explicit observed or separately opted-in PIT-modelled gallon share and independently archived remaining-period estimate; missing inputs block, no calendar substitute
historical_disclosure_example: Verify and reaggregate existing Q2 2025 frozen modelled-share replay; preserve strict replay block and original retrospective role; not a new backtest of market calibration
current_shadow: 2026Q3 post-path research only; no automatic promotion or current-quarter publication claim
limitations: Quarterly labels supervise inferred weekly allocations, not observed weekly company margins; historical market vintages not verified in this experiment
